notes: arsenal/media/peaks.py: waveform peaks without BBC audiowaveform. One ffmpeg decode to s16 PCM streamed through numpy; writes audiowaveform v2 .dat and .json (peaks.js, waveform-data.js, any canvas: pixel x covers samples [x*spp, (x+1)*spp) after start_s) and a wavesurfer.js v7 peaks file. Cached per source id + params under <state>/peaks/. The ffmpeg that arsenal.media.ff locates is a separate process whose licence depends on the build; the one saved on this machine is configured --enable-gpl --enable-version3, so it is not asserted here.
